page.overview:
What is Beskar spear?

A beskar spear was wielded by the Magistrate Morgan Elsbeth on Corvus during the New Republic Era. The staff was made of pure beskar, a metal alloy tied with Mandalorian culture.

Between 9 BBY and 2 BBY, Morgan used the spear to defend herself and fight the Noghri assassin Rukh, defeating him.

After the fall of the Galactic Empire, between 5 ABY and 9 ABY, the New Republic Ambassador Nadura traveled to Corvus in hopes for the planet to join the Senate. After a heated argument in which Morgan refused to join the Senate and turn herself in, she ordered her guards to kill Nadura and her delegation, using the spear to kill one of them.

By 9 ABY, Morgan used the spear to fight the Force-sensitive Ahsoka Tano, but was defeated by the former Jedi. Tano gifted the staff to the Mandalorian Din Djarin. The staff was durable enough to be able to block and deflect lightsaber blows
